Fujifilm and Tata Electronics ink pact for semiconductor growth in India

Fujifilm has entered into a partnership with Tata Electronics aimed at boosting semiconductor manufacturing and growth within India. The agreement signifies Fujifilm's strategic investment in the Indian market for semiconductor-related business. This collaboration is expected to leverage the strengths of both companies to advance the semiconductor sector in India. Specific details of the pact and the projected impact on India's growth were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
